pages.text: A cave light that runs on one Power Cell. Light $(bold)14$(), no grid.

pages.title: Cell
pages.text: Use a cell on it to insert or swap. $(bold)Shift$() with an empty hand removes it.$(br2)It draws $(bold)50 W$() while on: a full cell lasts about $(bold)2 h 47 min$().

pages.title: Placing
pages.text: Floor, wall or ceiling, underwater too. Empty-hand use switches it.$(br2)Break it to carry it; the cell, charge and switch go with it.

pages.title: In Hand
pages.text: Lit in your $(bold)offhand$() only; press F to move it there. $(bold)Shift-use$() in the air switches it while held.$(br2)Other slots don't light or drain.
Crafted empty. Empty ones stack to 16; loaded ones take a slot each.$(br2)$(flavor)Cheaper than torches. Eventually.$()
